_comment: Ordered fallback pool of OpenRouter models used for EVERY LLM task in this pipeline (extraction, classification, dedup, etc. all share this one list -- see project notes). Order matters: earlier entries are tried first; call_structured rotates the starting point on a schema-validation retry so a bad response from one model doesn't get retried against the exact same model. Edit this list to update the pool without a code change -- verify replacements are free-tier (':free' suffix, $0 prompt/completion) and text-capable on https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models before adding them. Selected 2026-08-11 by filtering OpenRouter's live catalog for $0-priced ':free' models, prioritizing native structured-output support, then context length and provider diversity.
